title: [Used] Qantas Group Full Bar Cart 10 Empty Drawers 50,000 Pts or $369 Shipped (Select Areas Only, Ex. WA, TAS, NT) @ Qantas Wine
body:
Deal: [Used] Qantas Group Full Bar Cart 10 Empty Drawers 50,000 Pts or $369 Shipped (Select Areas Only, Ex. WA, TAS, NT) @ Qantas Wine

[Fuzor] I remember this being super popular during covid but cannot imagine it as being anything more than a piece of 20kg eyesore in the home for all those who bought them. It definitely do not look "pre-loved", more of a well-rolled in faeces carpet trolley, now ready for your home carpet
[Wiadro] with items which were close to their use by dates
[SBOB] close to their use by dates
Challenge accepted
[boretentsu] Who bought one and what are they doing with them now?
[dnw213] Yesss been waiting for this deal all year!
[Wiadro] YOLO i got one, hopefully isnt a completely f'ed one
i might wrap it in matt silver if it is
ive seen these sell for 800 on fbmp
also youll earn 1,107 Qantas Points
[beastmodeactivated] Approx. $280 if you have qantas club plus and use a $50 dollar wine voucher. Not too bad.
[bluepop] Seems like clutter…Will this spark joy every time you roll it out?
[icw] im sorry..why would people buy this lol?

oh wait, that doesn't explain the list.
[EatThinkDrinkPremium] What comes off the aircraft last? This or the poor wheelchair user?

[Raj09] They have to pay me to get this. What's the use? Who thought to sell this crap?
[Headless] Considering the tattered reputation of Qantass, I just don't understand how these are still popular
